title: Fail-fast hardening for feedback contradictions/evaluation preflight + feedback integrity diagnostics

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Starting implementation. Scope locked: global fail-fast preflight for contradictions/evaluation, shared typed diagnostics, integrity surfacing in feedback/report CLI, and tests/docs updates.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Implemented production hardening scope: added shared feedback-analysis preflight validator with typed diagnostics; contradictions now fail-fast on preflight and emit structured counters (feedback_items_fetched, eligible_items, cache_hits, generated); evaluate feedback --version now runs preflight and hard-fails with remediation on missing prerequisites; added global feedback integrity scanner and new CLI command 'plexus feedback report integrity'; added runbook documentation and targeted tests. Targeted test suite passed: 53 passed.
